expectations.reason: LoanID must not be null as it uniquely identifies each loan.
LoanID values must be unique to avoid duplicate loan records.
AccountID must not be null to link loans to accounts.
AccountID has high unique count but duplicates are possible if multiple loans per account.
LoanStatusID must not be null to indicate loan status.
LoanStatusID must be one of the standardized status codes: 1 (Active), 2 (Closed), 3 (Default).
PrincipalAmount must not be null as it represents the loan amount.
PrincipalAmount minimum must be greater than 0 to ensure valid loan amounts.
InterestRate must not be null as it is essential for loan calculations.
StartDate should not be null to track loan start.
EstimatedEndDate should not be null to track loan end.
